name: The Historic Cotton Tree
subtitle: A national symbol that stood in the centre of Freetown until a storm felled it in May 2023.

facts.label: Size and age
facts.value: About 70 m tall, roughly 400 years old (estimates vary)

facts.label: Legend
facts.value: Returnees prayed under it in the late 1700s

facts.label: Setting
facts.value: Roundabout near the national museum, post office and highest court

parts.text: A national symbol that stood in the centre of Freetown until a storm felled it in May 2023. Locals say returning settlers prayed under it in the late 1700s, and it once towered over a busy roundabout near the national museum.
